description: Transparent post-mortem review of frozen decisions; no automatic NZX machine learning or real trades.

lessons.title: Earlier NZX penny-share screen was too permissive
lessons.detail: 1 frozen legacy idea(s) were generated below NZ$0.10. A later, more conservative screen now excludes new paper entries at those prices. Original decisions are preserved for accountability.
lessons.change: New NZX paper-entry gate requires a price of at least NZ$0.10. This is a risk guardrail, not a proven return advantage.

lessons.title: No completed paper outcomes yet
lessons.detail: Scout cannot tell you which selection rules are profitable until later verified closes, costs and sufficient independent weeks have been recorded. It must not call a pending paper idea a win or a mistake.
lessons.change: Keep collecting outcomes without rewriting the original rules.

feedback_policy.step_1: Freeze the original score, source evidence, costs, entry and selling rule at the time of decision.
feedback_policy.step_2: Observe later market-session prices and record fills or missed entries, never fill same-day or retrospectively.
feedback_policy.step_3: Explain negative outcomes and missed opportunities, preserving earlier mistakes.
feedback_policy.step_4: Compare at least 12 closed results from six distinct independent weeks per method before proposing any changed selection rule.
feedback_policy.step_5: Keep revised rules in an independent shadow test before allowing them to affect future rankings. Do not train on NZXplorer data without written permission.

licensing: NZXplorer expressly prohibits training ML/AI on its data without written permission. This is a non-training accountability review only.
limitations: Closed paper outcomes are not evidence of future investment profits.
NZX rules have been revised for risk control; no independent validation of an accuracy improvement yet.
US statistical learning retains its pre-existing independent validation gates.
